eid_r.declaration: SimpleLoop has no native evaluator identity (adapter_contract.md §5.2: native_scheme=none). The adapter pins EID* and is the sole source of the identity. EID_r.value is sha256("a0/simpleloop/eid_r/v1" + 0x00 + canonical_json(payload)) with payload = {schema, eid_star, evaluator_source_records, policy_digest} — the same domain-separated construction a0/contract/evalcontract.py uses for its own components. A third party recomputes it from EID*.json, a0/tasks/circle-packing/{e_star.py,e_star_child.py} and a0/runtimes/simpleloop/policy/simpleloop.policy.json alone, without running this adapter: a0/runtimes/simpleloop/tools/recompute-eid-r prints the payload and the digest, and the adapter publishes the same (domain, payload_canonical) pair in its conformance document. It changes iff EID*, the evaluator bytes, or the frozen selection/scalarization policy changes.
